footer:
Your choice — one question (it depends on what the desk does today):
A · No receipts outside Black Belt (as today) — pick this if the desk never hands out receipts. + no work. − if a family asks, staff write one in a paper receipt book that doesn't match the app.
B · Recommended: Black Belt's “Print receipt” in every section (right side) — pick this if receipts are given when a family asks. + one receipt everywhere, made from the recorded payment, already approved for Black Belt. − the desk needs a working printer (or saves a PDF until email exists).
C · B plus a Print receipt button in the Mark paid box, right after saving — pick this if every family gets a receipt. + no trip to the ⋯ menu. − one more step for everyone else; close to the per-payment slip you rejected for Black Belt.
